title: fix(onboarding): explain unavailable native capability on updated Windows
body:

Related: [#1754](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/issues/1754) ([Windows ARM64] Companion gives misleading build guidance when Native Gateway capability check fails): already-updated devices get update advice without an explanation of the failed capability.

## What Problem This Solves

<!--
Describe the concrete user, product, or operational problem.
Use one short, plain-language sentence. For fixes, prefer:
"Fixes: <what goes wrong> when <trigger or condition>."
For other changes, describe the need without inventing a bug.

Fixes misleading native Gateway update guidance when Windows is already new enough but its isolation-session capability is unavailable.

## User Impact

<!--
"User impact: <what users, operators, or developers can now do or expect>."
Lead with the concrete outcome in plain language, usually one sentence.

All six languages name the unavailable capability, explain that a newer Windows version alone does not guarantee availability, and offer the existing WSL or existing-Gateway routes. Reopening the page rechecks support. Older-system enrollment instructions and the clean-reinstall warning remain conditional; no update, rollout or OS-level fix is promised.

## Why This Change Was Made

<!--
Briefly explain how the change addresses the problem without repeating the impact.
Keep the body short. Leave file lists, internal acronyms, and root-cause walkthroughs
in the diff or optional <details>; include technical detail only when it explains
behavior or a material tradeoff. Do not hide risks or required actions in <details>.
-->

Presentation-only repair in the existing native eligibility renderer and resources. `NativeGatewaySetupEligibility` and its live capability gate are unchanged; Windows version never grants eligibility. The complete localized text remains the accessible name, with alternatives replacing the former rollout-promise emphasis.

Builds on Natalie Aguinaldo and Karen Lai's [#1654](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/pull/1654) (fix(onboarding): clarify native gateway update guidance): their localized enrollment tradeoffs and rich-text/accessibility renderer are retained, not superseded.

The preserved production-fix commit is `7a87e31f`. Two authorized test-only follow-ups add the bounded unavailable-Welcome Light/Dark entrypoint and an exact OCR-title exception. Existing ownership, isolation, source/binary, foreground and scroll guards remain. The exception only permits expected `Set up OpenClaw` with observed `Set up OpenCIaw` after both OCR passes, then requires exact visible native UIA and original-pixel review. It does not normalize I/l broadly or relabel failed OCR as successful.

## Evidence

<!--
Show the most useful proof that this change works. Screenshots, screencasts,
terminal output, focused tests, CI results, live observations, redacted logs,
and artifact links are all useful. Include before/after evidence for visual
changes when it clarifies the result.

Reviewers will inspect the code, tests, and CI. Use this section to make the
validation easy to understand, not to restate the diff.
Summarize what was checked and the result; note meaningful gaps. Link long output
or put it in optional <details>, keeping the useful evidence summary visible.
-->

Before the repair, all six new localized guidance regressions failed while all six existing enrollment/recheck cases passed. The post-fix localization/emphasis/UX selection passed 65 tests; unchanged eligibility tests passed 20. Seven native renderer/accessibility transition tests passed. Historical zh-CN/zh-TW synthetic native control captures were separately inspected, not claimed as shipped locale selection.

**Current-head full Welcome evidence:** the single approved fresh two-theme run at `cba3d9fb` passed **2 tests, 0 failures/skips**, with four inspected original PNGs covering top/bottom viewports in Light and Dark. Both manifests have `AllViewportsCaptured=true` and source verification. Native is disabled; WSL/existing choices are enabled; full status accessible-name assertions passed. Both bottom captures show the complete reopen/recheck sentence. This is a synthetic unavailable-state projection on the real production page, not live false-capability or installation proof.

Dark's two frames retain `machineOcrPassed=false` and `machineOCR-unverified; manualreviewrequired`. Exact owned, visible native UIA identifies `Set up OpenClaw` with in-capture bounds; original pixels were separately inspected by the coordinating assistant and independent reviewers. Light's two OCR passes succeeded. Machine manifests still have `acceptedForDesktop=false`, an unconditional machine-manifest classification, not a requirement for separate human sign-off. The approved visual-evidence contract accepts agent-inspected current-head original pixels. No automatic or human-review receipt was fabricated.

**Still held, not ready to merge:** final-head CI is green and three fresh independent reviews found no actionable P0-P3 defect, but their overall estimates are **87%, 93% and 90%**, below the required unanimous 95%. Source estimates are 93%, 96% and 95%, respectively (actual tool-reported models: Opus 5.5, Sol, Sol). All inspected all four originals and accepted the clarified agent-inspection contract. All classify the local Shared privilege gap as immaterial to the changed owners while retaining the actual failure, not claiming a green floor or exact-head Shared pass. No scores were rounded up and no further score-seeking cycle is planned.

Their remaining uncertainty concerns synthetic rather than live false-capability-host proof and exact-head capable Shared coverage. One also names unobserved native-error-page presentation, current-head non-English rendering and actual continuation of the alternative flows. These are evidence limits, not demonstrated product defects or authorization to expand into installation/OS changes. Earlier reviewers' scores are not carried forward; their contexts became unavailable, so these replacements started only after genuine full-page evidence existed.

Current source: `cba3d9fbad9f797c9fc22cf1d358045c74c75cc7`; comparison base `1beeb01f8e4a19741159440f0baeef8b8210c098`. Native Windows ARM64. No installs, provisioning, OS/privilege changes or shared Gateway/runtime changes.

| Exact command | Actual result |
|---|---|
| `.\build.ps1` | Passed all five projects at current head. |
| `dotnet test .\tests\OpenClaw.Shared.Tests\OpenClaw.Shared.Tests.csproj --no-restore` | **Not passed:** 4,791 passed, 26 skipped, 1 failed. The unchanged symbolic-link fixture cannot create its link because the host lacks the privilege. |
| `dotnet test .\tests\OpenClaw.Tray.Tests\OpenClaw.Tray.Tests.csproj --no-restore` | 4,735 passed, 0 failures/skips. |
| `dotnet build .\tests\OpenClaw.Tray.UITests\OpenClaw.Tray.UITests.csproj -c Debug -r win-arm64 --verbosity quiet` | Passed, 0 warnings/errors. |
| `dotnet test .\tests\OpenClaw.Tray.UITests\OpenClaw.Tray.UITests.csproj --no-build --no-restore -c Debug -r win-arm64 --filter 'FullyQualifiedName~OnboardingNativeProofTests'` | 16 passed, 0 failures/skips. Before the exact exception, both new positive cases failed for the intended missing exception while 14 guard cases passed. |
| `dotnet test .\tests\OpenClaw.Tray.UITests\OpenClaw.Tray.UITests.csproj --no-build --no-restore -c Debug -r win-arm64 --filter 'FullyQualifiedName~UnavailableWelcome_AllScrollViewports_WithManualForegroundAdmission' --logger 'console;verbosity=normal' --logger 'trx;LogFileName=welcome.trx' --results-directory <isolated-proof-root>` | 2 passed, 0 failures/skips. Four original viewport captures inspected; Dark failed-OCR/native-UIA distinction retained. |
| `git diff --check` | Passed. |

Historical focused checks at the preserved production-fix head `7a87e31f`:
- `dotnet test .\tests\OpenClaw.Tray.Tests\OpenClaw.Tray.Tests.csproj --no-restore --filter 'FullyQualifiedName~NativeGatewaySetupUxContractTests|FullyQualifiedName~NativeGatewayEmphasisRangesTests|FullyQualifiedName~LocalizationValidationTests'`: 65 passed, 0 skipped.
- `dotnet test .\tests\OpenClaw.SetupEngine.Tests\OpenClaw.SetupEngine.Tests.csproj --filter 'FullyQualifiedName~NativeGatewaySetupEligibilityTests'`: 20 passed, 0 skipped.
- `dotnet test .\tests\OpenClaw.Tray.UITests\OpenClaw.Tray.UITests.csproj --no-build --no-restore -c Debug -r win-arm64 --filter 'FullyQualifiedName~NativeGatewayEligibilityTextTests|FullyQualifiedName~FollowupProof_CapabilitiesAndWelcome'`: 7 renderer/accessibility tests passed; both older full-page gallery cases failed at foreground admission, no selected skips.
- `.\scripts\validate-docs.ps1`: passed, 68 Markdown files and proof-pool flow checks.

Failures are preserved, not repaired outside scope: the original Shared run had 4,790 passed/26 skipped/2 failures, including WebSocket teardown `OperationCanceledException: Aborted` / disposed WebSocket and the symlink privilege failure. One unchanged-head focused rerun (`--filter 'FullyQualifiedName~OwnedJunctionAndSymbolicLinkAreRejectedWithoutFollowingTheirChildren|FullyQualifiedName~Interactive_QuestionRecoveryAcrossSocketsAndResolutionBroadcast'`) passed the WebSocket and junction cases, still failed symbolic-link creation: 2 passed/1 failed/0 skipped. Later full runs also pass WebSocket. Full original logs/stacks/TRX remain retained. Shared production/tests were not edited.

Earlier bounded proof attempts are also retained: `8450e0b9` first run 0 passed/2 admission timeouts; user-run `human1` 1 Light passed/1 Dark OCR-title failure, with three PNGs. The exact exception was explicitly approved before the single fresh successful current-head run. No deterministic blind retry or failure erasure.

Historical [CI run 40818272515, attempt 1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/actions/runs/40818272515) succeeded for prior head `8450e0b9`. Actual UI checkout: merge `0cd167b1`, merging that head into `5daead32131b9b0a7b90dd11ad98ced6da147d61`. All nine downloaded TRX have 0 failures: Tray 4,735/0 not executed; Setup 2,484/1; Integration 55/3; Dev settings 31/0; native UI 576/35; accessibility 23/0; functional UI 19/0; UI after-check 12/0; WSL setup/connect 43/7. **Core and CLI was skipped.** This is not current-head CI or Shared execution.

Current-head [CI run 40820545085, attempt 1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/actions/runs/40820545085) completed **SUCCESS** for `cba3d9fbad9f797c9fc22cf1d358045c74c75cc7`. Actual UI checkout: merge `5f098003e107ede6a5f53e906bfae8734356d3cf`, with parents `5daead32131b9b0a7b90dd11ad98ced6da147d61` and the candidate. All nine downloaded TRX have 0 failures: Tray 4,735 passed/0 not executed; Setup 2,484/1; Integration 55/3; Dev settings 31/0; native UI 592/35; accessibility 23/0; functional UI 19/0; UI after-check 12/0; WSL setup/connect 43/7. All 16 OCR-policy and 7 eligibility-renderer cases passed in CI.

**Core and CLI was explicitly skipped.** Those reports contain no Shared/link/WebSocket execution, so this is not a final-head Shared pass. CI Gate and all selected jobs passed; the live PR was clean and mergeable. Ordinary skips are not custom-proof passes. The manual `NativeOnboardingProof` category is excluded from default unattended UI CI; its separate current-head local 2/2 result is above. No workflow was dispatched: the upstream dispatch has no scoped Core-only validation input, and the fork has no enabled `ci.yml` workflow. No release, Store or signing action was authorized.

**Bounded neighboring Shared evidence, not a current-head pass:** [Core job 123251987139 in run 40813996343](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/actions/runs/40813996343/job/123251987139), neighboring head `d39af91d04dd53e3e0e701f47fb8903413002d1b`, ran Shared: 4,811 passed, 8 not executed, 0 failed. Both junction/symbolic-link cases and WebSocket recovery passed. Fifteen checked trees/blobs match current head: Shared production, its MXC test subtree, interactive owner, fixture server, four project files and checked dependency/build manifests. **The complete graph is not identical:** `GatewayFixtureProtocolTests.cs`, `GatewayScenario.cs` and added `UsagePeriodFixture.cs` differ. No binary equality or final-head Shared pass is claimed. Independent reviewers must assess materiality for this resource/renderer/gallery-only change.

Exact-head Shared recovery on an existing authorized symlink-capable host: use a task-owned checkout at `cba3d9fb`, set `$env:OPENCLAW_REPO_ROOT=(Get-Location).Path`, then `dotnet test .\tests\OpenClaw.Shared.Tests\OpenClaw.Shared.Tests.csproj --logger 'trx;LogFileName=shared.trx' --results-directory .\artifacts\proof-cba3d9fb-shared`. First-run restore is allowed by this command rather than accepting absent test assets. Require actual executed cases, 0 failures and both link cases plus WebSocket recovery passed. No host was provisioned or local privilege changed here.

- PR head or commit tested: `cba3d9fbad9f797c9fc22cf1d358045c74c75cc7`; clean source, 2,015 tracked source files and 258 native-output files frozen before capture and rechecked afterward with 0 mismatches.
- Exact steps or command run: the two-case native test command above, via session-local `prove-welcome-cba3d9fb.ps1`. Explicit manual-focus opt-in, legitimate physical admission for the owned window, existing source/build manifests and isolated `OPENCLAW_TRAY_*` roots. No shell focus workaround or full gallery.
- Evidence after fix: `Test Run Successful. Total tests: 2. Passed: 2.` Both manifests have `AllViewportsCaptured=true`, `sourceVerifiedAfterCapture=true`. Dark title receipts: `Expected="Set up OpenClaw"; ActualName="Set up OpenClaw"; ControlType.Text`, wholly visible inside the owned capture. Both retain `machineOcrPassed=false`.

- Screenshot or artifact links verified? (`Yes`/`No`/`N/A`): N/A for public screenshots. The app's typed-attachment publication failed with `artifact io error: path not found`; no public screenshot link or successful upload is fabricated. No private local path is presented as a public attachment.
- Not verified or blocked: the unanimous 95% overall review gate and exact-head capable Shared execution. All three reviews are complete with no source defect, and all classify the local privilege issue as immaterial to this diff; their remaining proof uncertainty is preserved above. Synthetic rendering is not live false-capability reproduction, OS-update success, installed-package or Gateway proof. No source repair is indicated merely to chase confidence.

Separate `inspection.json` labels coordinating-assistant visual inspection, not a fabricated human or OCR pass.

Historical synthetic CJK control evidence at `7a87e31f`: installed SDK `10.0.26100.0\arm64\makepri.exe` ran `& $makepri createconfig /cf $config /dq $locale /pv 10.0.0 /o` and `& $makepri new /pr $inputs /cf $config /in OpenClaw.Tray.WinUI /of $pri /o`, for zh-CN/zh-TW byte-identical committed RESW inputs. Only the copied fixture PRI changed. `dotnet vstest <copied-output>\OpenClaw.Tray.UITests.dll /TestCaseFilter:FullyQualifiedName=OpenClaw.Tray.UITests.NativeGatewayEligibilityTextTests.Apply_UnavailablePreservesLocalizedParagraphsEmphasisAndAccessibleName /Logger:console;verbosity=detailed /Logger:trx;LogFileName=control.trx /ResultsDirectory:<locale-proof-root>` passed 1/1 per locale, 0 skips. Both captures were inspected for glyphs, wrapping, three paragraphs and final recheck text. Committed RESW/DLL/PNG hashes and exact expanded commands remain in `cjk-control-proof\provenance.json`; all copied binaries were unchanged. This is historical synthetic control rendering only, not current-head test binaries, shipped locale selection or both-theme locale proof.

Owned current-run PID 39068 exited naturally; the exact agent-run profile was removed, evidence retained and the visible slot explicitly released to Usage/parent. The earlier completed user-run `human1` profile remains deliberately preserved pending separate cleanup authority. No active task-owned runtime remains.
